notes: Checks suggested: (1) n 1294 'Unst (XIV.)': XIV is Pentland Skerries, not Unst (IV). Confirm it is a misprint. (2) n 1517 'the island': resolve from the surrounding text. (3) n 602 'Hoy Sound': I gave both Hoy lights. Make it a place if it is general text. (4) Short names given as stations: 'Dunnet' (n 323, 5 obs), 'Noss' (n 961), 'Sumburgh' (n 1239), 'Unst' (n 1293, 8 obs). Check each observation, since some may be the village or island rather than the light. (5) Places that may actually be keeper returns: Lerwick (Bressay), Wick (Noss Head), Loch of Cliff and Hermaness (North Unst), Firth of Forth (Forth stations). (6) Uncertain identifications: Glenboerie (Glenbervie, Larbert?), Monyruy (Longside), Hvidenov (Hvítanes), Kincardine (on-Forth or the county?), Bell Pock (Bell Rock). (7) Several items are not on the east coast of Scotland (Faroe, Lewis/Harris, Rum, Rothesay, Girvan, Dumfries/Solway, Northumberland). They are kept as places, but check that their section tags are right.
